headline: Recovered a cut-off codex arc: six verified root fixes were shipped to the working tree but never committed; recovery verified them REAL, caught one regression the project's own gate would have blocked, and landed the boundary.

items.title: Recovery is verification, not restoration
items.insight: S283's audit log claimed all six items shipped; recovery treated that as a claim to test. build:check surfaced a real regression S283 introduced (waitUntil:'networkidle' on the beacon-heavy /oracle/, the S223 30s-timeout trap that check-e2e-networkidle exists to catch). Committing as-is would have pushed a CI landmine.

items.title: Public AI-discovery derives from committed source, fails closed
items.insight: build-agents-json + build-llms-full-shards now read committed api/ecosystem-state.json instead of gitignored IGNIS state, so local can no longer disagree with the committed site while CI silently skips generation.

items.title: Genius List stops deleting its best task on a word
items.insight: A precise metadata-only classifier replaces prose matching, so the top verified Lighthouse task no longer vanishes because a sentence contains 'carry'.

items.title: Oracle reads public feeds once, no 404 stampede
items.insight: Both Oracle runtimes default to /api/* behind a shared promise cache; production /ignis/output/* probes are structurally forbidden. Ends the ~57-request stampede without expanding public exposure.

items.title: Skip-CI publisher validates staged truth before commit
items.insight: The half-hour uptime publisher now runs focused contracts before git add; any red aborts before a skip-CI commit can arm the next ordinary push.

items.title: Both Lighthouse gates share one fail-closed volatility policy
items.insight: Extracted a shared pure policy module; floor 0.76 and the >=2-of-5 tripwire preserved, nothing lowered. Resolves the standing S282 #1 carry using the re-run proof S282 already gathered.

items.title: Closeout no longer claims a mirror it never performs
items.insight: Removed the false self-copy that manufactured the bogus 893-vs-1278 blocker (and invited a CANON-018-violating cross-repo write). The local 893-record ledger is the project's own CI-readable truth.

followUps: Confirm the recovery push is green in CI (e2e compliance job exercises the shared Lighthouse policy + Oracle public-feed contract end-to-end).
Finish the second-order innovation pack S283 only started: build-release-proof holds honest-dark on stagingParity; deploy-staging is unwired/founder-gated.
